title: PCB layout
description: How a pcb is laid out, as data (#SECTION): a new pcb from its circuit, the parts added to one later, what a part with no footprint takes, the marks a placement machine finds a pcb by, the letters the pcb's own parts are named with, how near the ends of an edge being drawn join, and the copper stacks a pcb is made with. One home: the engine lays out with it, and the editor is served it (GET /pcb/standards) for what it draws and sets out while a hand works.

$schema.description: the schema this file is written to

circuit.description: a new pcb laid out from its circuit's sheet

partsShare.description: the share of the pcb the parts' own area fills

gap.description: how far apart two courtyards stand at least, in millimetres

grid.description: the grid every part stands on, in millimetres

margin.description: how far the edge stands off every courtyard, in millimetres

passes.description: how many passes push the courtyards apart at most

planeInset.description: how far inside the edge the ground is poured, in millimetres

planeClearance.description: the gap the ground keeps from other nets, in millimetres

corner.description: the radius of the edge's corners, in millimetres

connector.description: the header the bench's nets come out on

footprint.description: the header's footprint, its number of pins written as {pins}

designator.description: the letters its designator starts with

beforeSheet.description: how far left of the sheet's leftmost part it stands, in the sheet's units

unseated.description: A part with no footprint read: a box this large, its courtyard this far round it, its designator this tall, in millimetres.

courtyard.description: how far its courtyard stands round the box, in millimetres

designatorHeight.description: how tall its designator is written over it, in millimetres

setOut.description: Parts set out in rows, each row no wider than rowWidth, margin apart and from the edge; a pcb drawn round them no smaller than least, in millimetres.

rowWidth.description: how wide a row of parts runs before the next row starts, in millimetres

margin.description: how far apart parts stand, and from the edge drawn round them, in millimetres

least.description: The least size a pcb is drawn at, in millimetres.

width.description: the least width, in millimetres: a pcb one could order however few its parts

fiducials.description: The footprint a fiducial stands on, the letters it is named with, and how far in from the edge's corners, in millimetres.

footprint.description: the footprint a fiducial stands on, by slug

designator.description: the letters a fiducial is named with, before its number

inset.description: how far in from the corners of the edge's box a fiducial stands, in millimetres

ownPlacementDesignator.description: the letters a part only the pcb has is named with, before its number

edgeJoinReach.description: how near, in millimetres, the end of an edge being drawn joins an open end already there

copperStacks.description: how many copper layers a pcb may be made with
